             - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
               from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=415. 
 
 
10/31/2001:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=610. 
 
 
10/30/2000:  Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
             - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
             - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
               from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1615. 
               Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
               Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
               consideration when using this data.

07/19/2000:  Data Logging Activated (mawn1b)

07/19/2000:  Station Update  
 
             - Comments:        Difficult to get to.  Access lane along  
                                drainage ditch plowed over and planted with 
                                corn.  Station located in a corner of a corn 
                                field next to drainage ditch, southwest of  
                                dairy farm. 
 
                                Station tripod not installed in the normal 
                                position with leg facing south.  This station 
                                instead appears to be installed with leg  
                                facing east.  Tripod Legs are mounted to 
                                wooden blocks, so position was left the same. 
                                However, did unbolt during update so wind 
                                sentry and solar panel could be installed 
                                without the need of a ladder.  Lag-bolt 
                                on northwest facing leg snapped as it was 
                                very rusted.  Lag-bolts on other two posts 
                                were replaced. 
 
                                General condition:  Complete overhaul as  
                                the existing station showed much wear. 
                                Concern about possible microclimate 
                                variabilities due to corn planted near 
                                the station and very tall weeds that  
                                covered the entire station plot.  Appears 
                                that no care is taken to clean weeds and 
                                grass at the station site. 
 
                                Updated station using datalogger and hardware 
                                that was used and displayed at AgExpo 2000. 
 
                                Modem was installed and RJ11 phone wire was 
                                connected as was the interface cable.  There  
                                was a green tab for Power and Ground, but  
                                nothing was connected as the installation  
                                was done as other modems (e.g. Belding).  Dial 
                                tone verified active phone line, but after 
                                returning from field, learned that modem  
                                wasn't picking up. 
 
                                - jtb 
                          
 
             - Leaf Wetness A:  New Hardware 
                                - Bracket mounted 3-feet from center of  
                                  tripod, 39-inches (~1m) high.  Mounted 
                                  on East leg, sensor facing north. 
 
             - Leaf Wetness B:  Not Installed 
 
             - Soil Temp A:     New Hardware 
                                - Installed at 2-inch depth, north of  
                                  southwest leg, north of Soil Temp B.   
                                  Soil cover=sod (no herbicide applied). 
 
             - Soil Temp B:     New Hardware 
                                - Installed at 4-inch depth, north of 
                                  southwest leg, south of Soil Temp A.   
                                  Soil cover=sod (no herbicide applied). 
 
             - Soil Moisture A: New Hardware 
                                - Probe installed east of southwest leg,  
                                  approx. one foot northeast of Soil  
                                  Moisture B.   
                                  Soil cover=sod (no herbicide applied). 
 
             - Soil Moisture B: New Hardware 
                                - Probe installed east of southwest leg,  
                                  approx. one foot southwest of Soil  
                                  Moisture A.   
                                  Soil cover=sod (no herbicide applied). 
 
             - Air Temp/RH:     New Hardware 
                                - Installed HMP45C, facing south, height 
                                  of 59" to 8th plate. 
                                  (requires mawn1b) 
 
             - Wind Vane:       New Hardware 
                                - Points to North 
 
             - Anemometer:      New Hardware 
                                - Points to South 
 
             - Pyranometer:     New Hardware 
                                - Mounted bracket facing to the southwest. 
                                   
             - Solar Panel:     New Hardware 
                                - Installed near the top of the mast, below 
                                  wind vane and anemometer.  Panel facing  
                                  south, tilted at 45-degrees. 
 
             - Precipitation:   New Hardware 
                                - Installed and leveled to existing pipe 
                                  located in the West section of station  
                                  plot. 
 
             - Modem:           New Hardware 
                                - Installed exisiting phone line.  Phone 
                                  company access box located in the western 
                                  section of station plot. 
                                - Connected using RJ11 connector 
  
 
             - Needs:          - Leaf Wetness B 
                               - North Leg Needs To Be Bolted (or maybe entire 
                                 station repositioned and secured to fence 
                                 posts).  Tripod not currently aligned in  
                                 the same position as other MAWN stations. 
                               - Pyranometer may need to be checked for level. 
                               - Herbicide needed above soil temps. 
                               - Troubleshoot modem - phoneline
